author: John Hammond
description:
I was messing around with Codex, Fabric, and Hunt.io on a live stream and started thinking about what cybersecurity research could look like inside Minecraft.

The idea was pretty simple: open directories become dimensions, files become mobs, and tools become weapons.

Full video: https://youtu.be/Neq3ydILwHI?si=INfeICFsHYxwtrex
title: Minecraft Meets Security Research
